A king has one thousand bottles for tomorrow's feast. But one of them hides a potion.
1,000 bottles · 1 potion
Whoever drinks it gets a bright green tongue, exactly one day later.
Green tongue after 1 day
The feast is in twenty four hours, and the king has only ten tasters.
24 hours · 10 tasters
Each taster can sip from as many bottles as they like, but there's only time for one round.
Only one round of tasting
How can ten tasters find the one potion bottle?
Find it with 10 tasters?
Pause, and comment your plan!
Comment your plan!
The trick is binary. Give the tasters the values one, two, four, eight, and so on, up to five hundred twelve.
Every bottle number from one to a thousand can be made by adding up some of those values.
Every number = a sum of them
Each taster sips from every bottle whose number uses their value.
Sip every bottle that uses your value
Let's try it with seven bottles, and three tasters: one, two, and four.
Try it: 7 bottles, 3 tasters
Bottle five is four plus one, so tasters four and one sip it. Bottle six is four plus two. And bottle seven uses all three.
The next day, tasters one and four have green tongues. Four plus one is five. It's bottle five!
Green: 4 + 1 = bottle 5
With ten tasters, the green tongues can point to any bottle up to one thousand and twenty three.
10 tasters → up to 1,023 bottles
The potion is found, and the feast is saved, in just one day.
Feast saved!
